spec_match.rationale: The decision logic mirrors the shipped Chromium mapping (SOCIAL_ENGINEERING + WARN -> SB_THREAT_TYPE_WARNABLE_SUSPICIOUS_SITE gated on kSuspiciousSiteWarnings, else SAFE) verbatim from url_lookup_service_base.cc, and every outcome branch cites its source; the page is explicit that a web page cannot invoke or observe the real verdict.

interactive.rationale: Two radio groups and a feature checkbox drive a live pipeline trace and outcome panel; the recreation's heed/bypass buttons record outcomes mapped to Chromium's WarningOutcome and HaTS did_proceed dimensions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises a pipeline walkthrough showing when pop-up, interstitial, or nothing appears; the page delivers exactly those three outcome kinds.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers level-0 (no warnings at all, including interstitials), Standard-tier exclusion, feature-flag-off downgrade to SAFE, and the confirmed-threat interstitial contrast.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5427561449521152 and the url_lookup_service_base.cc source that the logic mirrors.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pairs two live falsifiable script probes (API absence) with five manual assertions for the browser-UI contracts a page cannot script, each citing the pinning source/test; the served page shows the shared support panel at 2 pass / 0 fail / 5 blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP harness (scratchpad drive-ssw.mjs, headless Chrome via scripts/lib/cdp.mjs) verified 8/8 decision-tree checks including bypass/heed outcome recording and all four outcome branches, zero console errors; screenshots warning-decision-tree-{desktop,mobile}.png show the post-interaction state.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the pipeline mapping contract on every recompute (ssw-decision-tree-mapping) and the recreation outcome clicks (ssw-recreation-outcome); no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables; the selected-state inversion also inverts nested code chips; the secondary button overrides background and color together; outcome panels use accent borders on near-white only.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios/checkbox in fieldsets with legends, role=radiogroup labels, aria-live on the verdict and outcome regions, visible :focus-visible outlines, and the harness confirmed every interactive element has an accessible name.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check reported desktop OK (clean) and mobile OK; a per-concept CDP pass measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800, and both screenshots show unclipped, legible controls with min-height 2.75rem targets.

openQuestions.title: Add a screenshot or exact strings of the shipped pop-up once Chrome 152 reaches stable
openQuestions.detail: The recreation is honestly labelled and deliberately generic about wording ('varies by platform and release'). When the real UI is broadly observable, capture the actual desktop and Android presentation (respecting Google asset licensing — likely describe rather than embed) and tighten the recreation's annotations to the shipped strings.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible radio group driving live readout state walkthrough
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native form semantics (fieldset/legend, labelled radios) and announce dynamic state changes via live regions rather than visual-only updates.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Inputs are native radios/checkboxes inside fieldsets with legends; the verdict panel and outcome log carry aria-live=polite so the computed outcome and heed/bypass records are announced.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive-ssw.mjs a11y check: all interactive elements have accessible text (28/28).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible radio group driving live readout state walkthrough
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Make the whole labelled row the hit target and keep controls at comfortable tap sizes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each choice row is a label with min-height 2.75rem wrapping its input, and :has(input:checked) styles the selected row with an inverted, AA-contrast state.

summary: Canonical concept: drives the exact shipped decision logic (protection level x RT verdict x base::Feature) with a sourced pipeline trace, three honest outcome kinds, and a clearly-labelled annotated recreation of the pop-up whose heed/bypass buttons mirror Chromium's recorded outcomes. Verified headlessly via the repo CDP helper: 8/8 branch checks, 0 console errors, 0px overflow both classes.
